text:
B: Hiya! Can you hear me okay?
A: Yeah. Hiya.
B: I'm Jade, Barnsley.
A: Callum. Stockton.
B: Ooh, up north proper. Is it cold up there?
A: Same as anywhere, really.
B: Ha, fair. Erm, Megan said you were at uni? Engineering or something?
A: Civil engineering. Final year.
B: Dead clever. I couldn't do maths to save my life, I got a D. So what's your dissertation, is it bridges?
A: Drainage. New housing estates.
B: Oh, right. Is that, erm, like the drains?
A: Yeah, basically. Where the rain goes.
B: Ha, okay. Erm, what do you do when you're not at uni, then?
A: Gym. Saturdays at Morrisons. Walk the dog.
B: You've got a dog? What kind?
A: Staffy. Tyson.
B: Shut up! I've got a Staffy! Bella! Does he chew everything?
A: Chewed the remote last week. Third one.
B: Oh my god, so did Bella! On Tuesday! Liam had to get a new one off Amazon. I swear they've got like a group chat.
A: Probably. Tyson goes for the buttons. Picks them off one at a time.
B: Bella just eats the whole thing. She's lovely though.
A: Yeah. They're good dogs. People think they're nasty, they're not.
B: That's what I always say! So you work at Morrisons? I'm looking for something like that, to be honest, while I sort my nails out. I were a nail tech, the salon shut down, and Marijke said I should do pamper parties for kids, like little glitter nails and that.
A: That's not a bad idea.
B: Yeah? I just never get round to stuff. I've got all the kit sat in the spare room, but there's insurance and a booking thing and I don't even know where to start.
A: Insurance is just a form online. Takes about twenty minutes. Booking, you can just do a spreadsheet to start with. Name, date, time, paid or not. I do one for my money. Doesn't need to be fancy.
B: Twenty minutes? I thought it'd be like a whole day.
A: Nah. Do it tonight and it's done.
B: You're dead organised, aren't you?
A: Just like it sorted.
B: Morrisons, though, would they be hiring, do you reckon?
A: Ours had a sign up. Christmas temp stuff, usually. Worth asking at yours.
B: Yeah, I'll have a look at the one near us. Oh, I think we're nearly done.
A: Yeah. Do the insurance.
B: Ha, I will! Give Tyson a fuss from me.
